tools.name: search_insider_events
tools.description: Search interpreted insider-trading events from SEC Form 4 filings. Each event classifies raw filing rows into economic meaning (OPEN_MARKET_BUY vs EQUITY_AWARD vs TAX_WITHHOLDING_ONLY etc.), separating discretionary trades from compensation noise. Supports filtering by ticker, event type, minimum USD value, and time, with cursor pagination. Form 4 only - for 13D/G stakes or Form 144 sale notices use get_activist_stakes, get_sale_notices, or get_company_timeline. Data delayed 24 hours (known_at); history ~1 month; no price-derived fields.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol to filter by, e.g. AAPL or TSLA. Omit to search across all companies.
ticker.title: Ticker

event_type.description: Filter by interpreted event type. One of: OPEN_MARKET_BUY, OPEN_MARKET_SELL, PLANNED_10B5_1_SELL, OPTION_EXERCISE_HOLD, OPTION_EXERCISE_PARTIAL_SELL, OPTION_EXERCISE_FULL_SELL, TAX_WITHHOLDING_ONLY, EQUITY_AWARD, GIFT_TRANSFER, INDIRECT_OWNERSHIP_TRANSFER, OTHER_REQUIRES_REVIEW, JOINT_FILING_AMBIGUOUS, COMPLEX_DERIVATIVE_EVENT, UNCLASSIFIED. Use OPEN_MARKET_BUY for discretionary insider buying.
event_type.title: Event Type

since.description: Only return events recorded at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g. 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z). Compares against recorded_at — useful for incremental sync.
since.title: Since

min_value.description: Minimum trade value in USD (reported shares × reported price per share).
min_value.title: Min Value

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor — pass the next_cursor value from the previous response.
cursor.title: Cursor

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return. Default 20, maximum 200.
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: get_company_timeline
tools.description: Get one merged, time-ordered feed of SEC insider activity for a company: Form 4 events, Schedule 13D/13G stake filings, and Form 144 sale notices, distinguished by the source_form field (form4 | sc13 | form144). The limit applies after merging, so companies with heavy Form 4 activity can crowd out 13D/G and 144 rows - use the dedicated tools for those. Unknown tickers fail with an error (404). Data delayed 24 hours (known_at); no price-derived fields.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol of the company (issuer), e.g. AAPL or TSLA. Required.
ticker.title: Ticker

limit.description: Maximum number of timeline items after merging all form types. Default 50, maximum 300.
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: get_activist_stakes
tools.description: Get Schedule 13D/13G beneficial-ownership filings (activist and 5%+ large-holder stakes) for one company - ticker is required. Returns one row per filing with filer names and the maximum reported percent of class; detailed item narrative text is not included. event_revision is always null for these forms (a fact of the form, not missing data). Data delayed 24 hours (known_at); recent filings only.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol of the company (issuer), e.g. AAPL or TSLA. Required.
ticker.title: Ticker

limit.description: Maximum number of 13D/13G filings to return. Default 20.
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: get_sale_notices
tools.description: Get Form 144 notices of proposed insider sales for one company - ticker is required. shares_to_sell and aggregate_market_value are as-filed intentions announced before the sale, not executed trades - the matching Form 4 sale, if any, typically follows about a day later. event_revision is always null for this form. Data delayed 24 hours (known_at); recent filings only.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol of the company (issuer), e.g. AAPL or TSLA. Required.
ticker.title: Ticker

limit.description: Maximum number of Form 144 notices to return. Default 20.
limit.title: Limit
